scope: Prior-art boundary for a redshift-block stress test of the public DESI DR2 BAO Gaussian likelihood

verifiedPrecedents.alreadyEstablished: The official DR2 BAO analysis publishes the 13-element mean vector, covariance, likelihood, flat-LambdaCDM headline Omega_m=0.2975+-0.0086 and h r_d=101.54+-0.73 Mpc, and combined-probe tests of evolving dark energy.
verifiedPrecedents.rc61Difference: RC61 independently reconstructs the Gaussian fit, removes each of seven redshift blocks in turn, and freezes explicit refutation thresholds before interpreting the scale gap.

verifiedPrecedents.alreadyEstablished: Under base LambdaCDM, Planck reports H0=67.4+-0.5 km/s/Mpc and r_drag=147.09+-0.26 Mpc.
verifiedPrecedents.rc61Difference: RC61 uses the published marginals only as a transparent product-level diagnostic; it does not reproduce the Planck likelihood or treat the two marginals as independent in a definitive joint inference.

verifiedPrecedents.alreadyEstablished: Joint HST and JWST distance-ladder comparisons report H0=73.2+-0.9 for the full HST ladder and 72.6+-2.0 for the three-method JWST subset.
verifiedPrecedents.rc61Difference: RC61 converts these summaries into the ruler length required by DESI BAO, without re-fitting photometry, anchors, supernovae, or their covariance.

verifiedPrecedents.source: Recent sound-horizon-free and late-time analyses, arXiv:2505.01661, 2509.12331, 2512.07281, 2604.24050
verifiedPrecedents.alreadyEstablished: The literature already studies late-time expansion freedom, sound-horizon-free H0 inference, and shorter-ruler interpretations of DESI DR2. A short ruler or late-time bridge is therefore not a new concept.
verifiedPrecedents.rc61Difference: The contribution is a compact, reproducible decision audit: headline replication, leave-one-redshift-block influence, AICc penalties for two smooth extensions, and dual-language numerical agreement.

claimsNotMade: RC61 does not claim a new cosmological model.
RC61 does not establish that early-universe physics is the cause of the Hubble tension.
RC61 does not independently validate DESI tracer selection, reconstruction, covariance construction, Planck spectra, or local-ladder photometry.
The 4.016-sigma product diagnostic is not a substitute for a posterior-level joint likelihood.
